02 How it Works

Four Steps to
the Trailhead

No booking apps, no surprises. One trip planner looks after you from the first message to the last campfire.

  1. 01

    Pick a departure

    Choose a route and a date. Every trip lists daily distances, so you know exactly what you’re signing up for.

  2. 02

    Hold your seat

    A $300 deposit holds your place. Change your mind within 14 days and you get all of it back.

  3. 03

    Meet your guide

    A video call a month before you go: packing list, a simple training plan and all your questions.

  4. 04

    Just turn up

    Airport pickup, huts, meals and transfers are arranged. Bring boots and good company.
